reviews.comment: This is a class for you if you are willing to participate and read the books and reread articles she has posted for exams, the hardest part of her class were the two exams we took but they are open book you can bring basically anything except your written essay, the final exam is a guaranteed 100 as long as you post a 15 minute video.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor and a class worth taking, but be ready to read and participate. Tough grader, I felt I would have received an A if she graded like other professors but I did really enjoy the class and her lectures were fun.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Mills is an absolutely amazing, kind, and caring professor. But, she is a tough one. You play video games (which you have to buy), and write about it. However, be aware this is a very difficult class; you WILL be taken aback if you're not prepared. She grades harshly, but you have a chance to fix ALL of your papers in your final portfolio.

Dr. Mills is probably one of the coolest professors I've ever had. However, for the unprepared, her work load is pretty heavy, and she's a really harsh grader. The coolest thing about this class was that you got to play video games for homework. But if you already have a heavy course load, I'd take this during a diff semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This is a literature class, we read 3 books & 2 excerpts. Class is not mandatory but if you go participation is key. Going to class will help a lot with the exams considering they are in-class discussions based on the books you will need to read for the exam. Only graded on two exams and a final project as well as small in-class assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This is a literature class so expect to read a lot. We read three books in the spring and two excerpts. In class participation is also required since this is how you will be able to flesh out your ideas for the exam. So with this being said this is in a sense lecture heavy. Grades were mostly 2 exams and a final project. A fun class
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It's overly strict for an English class. She takes forever to grade assignments, will call on you, tough grader, and has absolutely no mercy with missing class. It doesn't matter if you have a school event, mental health issues, heavy work load & even if its your last semester. She will give you an ultimatum of drop of fail. Beware! Do not take!
One of my favorite classes ever.
Passionate and supportive, you'll be glad you took her class.

This class is interesting but and of heavy in workload. LOTS of reading. Isn't a class you can skip, every day there is a participation activity which is just getting points for being there. There are lots of opportunities for extra credit. I think she's a good prof, takes her passion for teaching seriously and she can be fun sometimes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: You learn a great deal, and her lectures are fun, but you will have to really work for a good grade. I did the best I could and still only managed a B, but I felt I earned it and I got more out of this class than most of the others I have taken.

Professor Mills gets you invested in the subject and is available to help when needed. I struggled early on, but spoke to her and she helped me get on track. The syllabus looks a bit overwhelming at first, but just do the work and turn stuff in on time and you'll be ok. One of my best experiences in an English class.

This class is unlike any English class I have ever taken because it's not even an English class. It's literally a political science or sociology class. She will want to have multiple discussions in class but if you disagree with her WATCH OUT! If you speak your opinion on the reading she won't hesitate to brag about her PHD and put you down.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Rants on about how her life is so hard. I do not mind if professors say bad words but she says them unnecessarily as if she's attacking her students. Even the people who are A+ students that participated in everything STRUGGLED. Grades very hard, even if you do the assignment correctly. Tries to communicate her grading standards then changes them.

One of the most confusing profs I've had. She's very unclear in her expectations and when you ask for guidance, she gets frustrated and says that students today expect too much "hand holding." We didn't get any actual grades for the class, just feedback on our essays. Our final was arguing what grade we thought we deserved based on our work.

Very passionate professor but a very tough grader. One of the toughest graders I have had. Classes can be interesting, very discussion heavy. A lot of work! Do not take if you work many hours, take many hours, have a busy schedule. Overall learned a lot, enjoyed the majority of the course.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: As a professor Mills is great and seems passionate about what she teaches. I also learned a lot from this class, and enjoyed the book discussions. BUT when it comes to being understanding Mills lacks. She is a very, tough grader, and is not very understanding. To receive an A you must have a 92 and up, also the syllabus was changed every 5 seconds.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Participation cards, 6 essays, huge project, random unnecessary assignments. An A is a 92 because she doesn't think a 90 is "good enough". The test are pretty easy only 10% of the grade. I'm borderline A but still might not get to that 92. I was excited for the readings but she made me hate the class and not truly focus on readings like I wanted to
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prepare to read. Prepare to write. Prepare to participate. Shes not lenient with grading papers, so dont expect an A unless it is her preferred style and format. Asked for help when I needed it but she wasnt helpful. Sink or swim here. Shes not very understanding if youre sinking...

I absolutely loved this class. She gave mini lectures and then spent most of the class just engaging with the students and the book of choice. I learned a lot and got to read a lot of stuff that I never get to read in other lit courses. Fair grader who actually cares about improvement. Really going to miss this class!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring
